title: Are SAE Features Stable Across Random Seeds? A Reproducibility Follow-Up

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Stability is a prerequisite for trusting SAE monitors (plausible chain) but link to catastrophic risk skips the deployment step.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Uses public SAEs, no training, simple correlation/matching; a motivated beginner can make progress.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped single measurement (best-match similarity distribution) with a well-defined success criterion.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Reproducibility audit on open SAEs is exactly independent-friendly third-party scrutiny labs underweight.

low_compute.reasoning: Loads pretrained SAEs and computes alignment; minimal compute.

novelty.reasoning: Cross-seed SAE stability is partly covered by SAEBench/sanity-check literature.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: SAEBench and stability literature already examine cross-SAE feature consistency.
